# Runtime-dispatch calls whose candidate methods `call_candidates` lists. Each function has four
# methods, past inference's three-method limit, so a call on a `Vector{Any}` element stays dynamic.
mutable struct Counter
    hits::Int
end
struct Circle end
struct Square end
struct Triangle end
struct Hexagon end

measure(::Circle, counter::Counter) = counter.hits
measure(::Square, counter::Counter) = counter.hits + 1
measure(::Triangle, counter::Counter) = counter.hits + 2
measure(::Hexagon, counter::Counter) = counter.hits + 3

tally(::Circle, counter::Counter) = (counter.hits += 1; nothing)
tally(::Square, counter::Counter) = nothing
tally(::Triangle, counter::Counter) = nothing
tally(::Hexagon, counter::Counter) = nothing

gathered(::Circle, counters::Counter...) = (first(counters).hits = 0; nothing)
gathered(::Square, counters::Counter...) = nothing
gathered(::Triangle, counters::Counter...) = nothing
gathered(::Hexagon, counters::Counter...) = nothing

relay(::Circle, counter::Counter, shapes::Vector{Any}) = tally(first(shapes), counter)
relay(::Square, counter::Counter, shapes::Vector{Any}) = nothing
relay(::Triangle, counter::Counter, shapes::Vector{Any}) = nothing
relay(::Hexagon, counter::Counter, shapes::Vector{Any}) = nothing

broken(::Circle, counter::Counter) = nothing
broken(::Square, counter::Counter) = nothing
broken(::Triangle, counter::Counter) = nothing
@generated broken(::Hexagon, counter::Counter) = error("this generator throws")

echo(::Circle, counter::Counter) = nothing
echo(::Square, counter::Counter) = nothing
echo(::Triangle, counter::Counter) = nothing
echo(shapes::Vector{Any}, counter::Counter) = echo(first(shapes), counter)

inspect(shapes::Vector{Any}, counter::Counter) = measure(first(shapes), counter)
record(shapes::Vector{Any}, counter::Counter) = tally(first(shapes), counter)
spread(shapes::Vector{Any}, counter::Counter) = gathered(first(shapes), counter, counter)
forward(shapes::Vector{Any}, counter::Counter) = relay(first(shapes), counter, shapes)
breaks(shapes::Vector{Any}, counter::Counter) = broken(first(shapes), counter)
splatted(shapes::Vector{Any}, counter::Counter) = measure(shapes..., counter)
